description: Midimalism is an architectural or interior design movement that serves as the sweet spot between maximalism and minimalism where a clever portmanteau of "mid" (middle) is presented, which is popularized and coined across design circles, targeting the collective fatigue of choosing between two restrictive extremes, along with stark sterility of extreme minimalism, the overwhelming, the cold, and the exhausting chaos of extreme maximalism.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): The balance between the maximalism and the minimalism
